note: Zoom on the pupils' corner of the lilac music room (cartoon style): lilac wall, pale wood floor, round lilac rug; a xylophone and drum on the back bench are scenery. Six separated, grounded figures, each with its own floor shadow (no row on a desk): back row afin (fan on its stand), lorsque (lobster snapping when the alarm clock rings), le demeurant (demure ant in a bonnet with the leftover cake, right half: masculine noun); front row soit (toy seesaw), puisque (whisk in its bowl), quoique (quacking duck). Conjunctions have no gender (divider null). Blank card on the wall is the sign. No painted back link: the PR 19 breadcrumb returns to the music room.

items.scene: two children on a toy seesaw swaying either way
red lobster snapping at the moment the alarm clock beside it rings
whisk standing in its mixing bowl
big open pink-flowered hand fan on its wooden stand
white duck quacking on, standing on the floor
demure ant in a bonnet beside the leftover slice of cake
